items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: He played with Mike Gouldie band.

ctx.x: Who did he play with down there?
He played with Mike Gouldie band. Uh huh. Mike Gouldie band. And uh, Harrison Bones, Pierre Anderson. He left the country and played with all the different bands. Chris Kelly.
Who did Pierre Anderson play with? I don't know about him.
